snippet.title: Holy Shroom! – Official Teaser | Relax by Day. Survive the Night.
snippet.description:
Holy Shroom! – Official Teaser

Mushroom picking has never been this dangerous.

Holy Shroom! is a photorealistic mushroom-foraging game for solo or co-op.
Pick, sell and upgrade by day. Stay after dark for rarer mushrooms — if you survive ghosts, monsters, aggressive animals and the strange residents of the forest.

Will you leave before nightfall… or risk it all for a full basket?

🍄 Wishlist Holy Shroom! on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5259850/Holy_Shroom/

Coming soon on Steam.
